cases.notes: Card IN-0309 'Ryerson' has wikidata Q7385029 (Ryerson, Inc., Chicago), website ryerson.com, iShares ticker RYZ, Crunchbase Ryerson (Chicago). The SEC registrant is the parent Ryerson Holding Corporation (CIK 1481582), which is the listed issuer (ticker was RYI in the 2024 10-K cover and is RYZ in the 2026 proxy, same CIK; the proxy mentions the combination with Olympic Steel). The card is the group's listed company, treated as the issuer; the operating subsidiary Joseph T. Ryerson & Son, Inc. is a different legal entity but the card is not it (listed on the ticker RYZ).
